nodes.title: Phase 29A production configuration contract
nodes.value: Supabase auth with authenticated audience; AI_VASTU_DATABASE_URL; validated web origins and trusted hosts; absolute durable storage roots; OpenRouter text/reasoning with direct Gemini plan vision; explicit gateway selection. PhonePe remains unimplemented and fail-closed.

nodes.title: Phase 29B auth and persistence hardening
nodes.value: Shared canonical access-token verification and current-owner gates cover project, billing, requirements, and confirmed-generation routes. Requirements files use atomic same-directory replacement; staging/production upload roots fail closed; backups cover PostgreSQL, requirements, and generation uploads. Live database isolation, services, and restore behavior remain unqualified.
provenance: pnpm validate on phase29 working tree, 2026-09-24

nodes.title: Phase 29C hybrid AI production integration
nodes.value: Production requires OpenRouter for text/reasoning and direct Gemini for persisted plan recognition. Provider retries, deadlines, response sizes, errors, uploads, environment selection, and rate-limit boundaries fail closed. AI observations remain advisory. Both live provider checks are blocked by absent credentials; visual requirements compatibility routing remains unresolved.
provenance: pnpm validate on phase29, 2026-09-27: 830 Python, 26 web, 1 contract

nodes.title: Phase 29D PhonePe and payment atomicity
nodes.value: PhonePe Standard Checkout v2 is launch-capable locally with persisted checkout intent, authoritative provider-status reconciliation, and atomic event/order/entitlement settlement. Replay, duplicate, stale-state, and concurrent settlement paths fail closed. Recurring products remain unavailable until genuine AutoPay exists. Live PhonePe, database, backup/restore, and deployment qualification remain outstanding.
provenance: Phase 29D local checkpoint: 940 Python tests, 32 web tests, Ruff PASS, mypy PASS across 208 files, Phase 29C and Phase 29D gates PASS

nodes.title: Superseded development agent model routing policy
nodes.value: Luna for mechanical; Sol for normal/complex implementation; Astra for critical review/decisions; GPT-5.3-Codex optional for agentic coding.
provenance: OpenAI model guidance current at package generation

nodes.title: Fixed development agent model policy
nodes.value: Vastudraw/Codex development uses GPT-5.6 Sol Medium for all agents and skills by default. Model or reasoning escalation requires explicit user approval. The Model Router routes roles, workflow, context, tests, reviewers, and human-review conditions, not model family or effort.
